title: Fix three bugs in a Go string utilities package
description: Fix bugs in strutil: IsPalindrome compares s[i] to itself, Reverse swaps element with itself, CountVowels missing 'u'.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in strutil.go:
1. IsPalindrome: change `s[i] != s[i]` to `s[i] != s[n-1-i]`
2. Reverse: change `runes[i], runes[i] = ...` to `runes[i], runes[n-1-i] = runes[n-1-i], runes[i]`
3. CountVowels: change `"aeio"` to `"aeiou"`
All 3 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
